payload.claim: This sentence says the constant mutant 'changes the value the diff gives a constant,' but after this change the mutated value can be a value the diff never touches at all. The spec's own fixture (criterion 1, `LONG`) edits only the fifth of nine string lines, deliberately keeping the opening-quote line (the `value` span that actually gets mutated) out of any hunk, so the diff gives that value nothing; `_candidate_constants` now finds it by searching the file's HEAD text and only uses the diff to confirm some other line of the same constant was added. The next two sentences of the same paragraph (lines 1195-1196) already state the corrected mechanism, so this earlier sentence is a leftover claim the change falsifies without updating it.
